Otherwise the stored current_actor is used\n  # (legacy/lobby mode).\n  def current_actor_for(campaign, turn_number = nil)\n    queue = campaign[:queue] || []\n    turn = turn_number.nil? ? campaign[:turn_number].to_i : turn_number.to_i\n    phase = campaign[:phase].to_s\n    return campaign[:current_actor] if queue.empty?\n\n    return 'dm' if phase == 'dm'\n\n    players = queue.reject { |actor| actor == 'dm' }\n    return 'dm' if players.empty?\n\n    players[(turn / 2) % players.length]\n  end\n\n  # Maps an actor name to the play-campaign phase label.\n  def phase_for(actor)\n    actor == 'dm' ? 'dm' : 'player'\n  end\n\n  # Advances a play campaign from a DM resolution to the next player turn.\n  # Returns the next actor's username (or 'dm' when there are no players).\n  def advance_play_campaign_turn!(campaign, current_turn_number)\n    next_turn_number = current_turn_number.to_i + 1\n    queue = campaign[:queue] || []\n    players = queue.reject { |actor| actor == 'dm' }\n    next_actor = players.empty? ? 'dm' : players[(next_turn_number / 2) % players.length]\n    Storage.update_play_campaign_turn(campaign[:id], next_actor, 'player', next_turn_number)\n    next_actor\n  end\n\n  # Advances a play campaign from a player action to the DM's resolution phase\n  # and increments the turn number. Returns 'dm'.\n  def advance_to_dm_phase_and_turn!(campaign)\n    next_turn_number = campaign[:turn_number].to_i + 1\n    Storage.update_play_campaign_turn(campaign[:id], 'dm', 'dm', next_turn_number)\n    'dm'\n  end\n\n  # Advances a play campaign from a player travel turn to the DM's resolution\n  # phase without incrementing the turn number. Returns 'dm'.\n  def advance_to_dm_phase!(campaign)\n    Storage.update_play_campaign_turn(campaign[:id], 'dm', 'dm', campaign[:turn_number].to_i)\n    'dm'\n  end\n\n  # Computes the deterministic initiative order for a campaign encounter from\n  # its monster roster and bound party combatants. Highest initiative wins;\n  # ties are broken by combatant name.\n  def encounter_order(monsters, combatants)\n    order = []\n    monsters.each do |m|\n      order << { name: m[:name], kind: 'monster', initiative: m[:initiative], internal_id: m[:monster_id] }\n    end\n    combatants.each do |c|\n      next unless c.is_a?(Hash)\n\n      order << {\n        name: c['name'] || c[:name],\n        kind: 'player',\n        initiative: c['initiative'] || c[:initiative],\n        member: c['member'] || c[:member]\n      }\n    end\n    order.sort! do |a, b|\n      if a[:initiative] != b[:initiative]\n        b[:initiative] <=> a[:initiative]\n      else\n        a[:name].to_s <=> b[:name].to_s\n      end\n    end\n    order\n  end\n\n  # Public active-combatant shape for encounter turn endpoints.\n  def encounter_active(combatant)\n    return nil unless combatant\n\n    { name: combatant[:name], kind: combatant[:kind], initiative: combatant[:initiative] }\n  end\n\n  # Computes the readiness/risk signal flags for a regular campaign. Returns the\n  # signals hash and the count of currently active quests.\n  def campaign_readiness_signals(campaign_id, campaign)\n    open_quests = Storage.campaign_quests(campaign_id).count { |q| q[:status] == 'active' }\n    signals = {\n      has_dm: campaign && !campaign[:dm].to_s.empty?,\n      has_characters: Storage.campaign_characters_count(campaign_id) > 0,\n      has_next_session: !Storage.next_campaign_session(campaign_id).nil?,\n      has_active_quest: open_quests > 0\n    }\n    [signals, open_quests]\n  end\n\n  # Legacy deadline value for a play campaign turn. Wall-clock time is not\n  # used in this benchmark; the deadline is derived deterministically from the\n  # current turn number.\n  def play_turn_deadline(turn_number)\n    return 0 if turn_number.nil?\n    turn_number + 3\n  end\n\n  # Logical integer deadline for a play campaign turn. The deadline is the\n  # logical turn number itself so a fresh turn is never overdue.\n  def play_logical_deadline(turn_number)\n    return 0 if turn_number.nil?\n    turn_number\n  end\n\n  # Builds an encounter summary for a campaign encounter. Looks up each monster\n  # slug in the compendium and halts 404 if any slug is missing.\n  def encounter_calculation(party, monster_slugs)\n    counts = Hash.new(0)\n    monster_slugs.each { |slug| counts[slug] += 1 }\n\n    monsters = []\n    counts.each do |slug, count|\n      monster = Storage.load_monster(slug)\n      json_error(404, 'monster not found') unless monster\n      monsters << { cr: monster[:cr], count: count }\n    end\n\n    thresholds = encounter_thresholds(party)\n    base_xp, monster_count = encounter_base_xp(monsters)\n    multiplier = encounter_multiplier(monster_count)\n    adjusted_xp = (base_xp * multiplier).to_i\n    difficulty = encounter_difficulty(adjusted_xp, thresholds)\n    recommendation = recommendation_for(difficulty)\n\n    [base_xp, adjusted_xp, difficulty, monster_count, recommendation]\n  end\nend\n\n# --- Health ---\n\nget '/health' do\n  content_type :json\n  JSON.dump(ok: true)\nend\n\n# --- Core dice and checks ---\n\npost '/v1/dice/stats' do\n  content_type :json\n  body = parse_json_body\n  expression = body['expression'].to_s\n\n  match = expression.match(/^(\\d+)d(\\d+)(?:([+-])(\\d+))?$/)\n  unless match && match[1].to_i.positive? && match[2].to_i.positive?\n    halt 400, JSON.dump(error: 'invalid expression')\n  end\n\n  modifier = 0\n  if match[3]\n    modifier = match[4].to_i\n    modifier = -modifier if match[3] == '-'\n  end\n\n  dice_count = match[1].to_i\n  sides = match[2].to_i\n\n  min = dice_count + modifier\n  max = dice_count * sides + modifier\n  average = (min + max).even? ? (min + max) / 2 : (min + max) / 2.0\n\n  JSON.dump(\n    dice_count: dice_count,\n    sides: sides,\n    modifier: modifier,\n    min: min,\n    max: max,\n    average: average\n  )\nend\n\npost D&D DM Tools — Codebase Guide\n\nThis is a small Sinatra API that provides dice, character, combat, compendium,\ncampaign, and DM-helper endpoints for a D&D 5e table. The implementation is\nintentionally minimal and deterministic: no background jobs, no external\nservices, and a single SQLite database file.\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nbundle install\nPORT=4567 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` starts the server in the foreground on `127.0.0.1` using the `PORT`\nenvironment variable. The same port is also read by `app.rb` as a fallback, but\n`run.sh` always passes it on the command line.\n\nVerify the server is up:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/health\n```\n\nExpected response:\n\n```json\n{ \"ok\": true }\n```\n\nStop the server with `Ctrl-C`.\n\n## Entry point and file layout\n\n```\napp.rb              # Sinatra application, route definitions, request helpers\nlib/\n  auth.rb           # Bearer-token authentication and password hashing\n  game_logic.rb     # Pure D&D 5e calculations and encounter constants\n  storage.rb        # SQLite persistence layer\n  validation.rb     # Input validation helpers\nrun.sh              # Foreground server launcher\nGemfile             # Pin: sinatra 4.2.1, rack 3.2.6, puma 8.0.2, sqlite3 2.9.5\n```\n\n`app.rb` requires the four libraries, configures the server bind address and\nport, initializes the SQLite schema, and then registers the helper modules and\nroutes. The app uses **classic Sinatra** style (`require 'sinatra'` and routes\ndefined at the top level) so that `ruby app.rb` works directly.\n\n## State, persistence, and request-routing design\n\n### Persistence\n\nAll durable state lives in `game.db` (SQLite). The `Storage` module owns every\nSQL statement and the single shared database connection. Key facts:\n\n- `Storage::DB_PATH` resolves to the project-root `game.db`.\n- `Storage::DB_MUTEX` serializes all database access because Puma may serve\n  requests concurrently and the Ruby `sqlite3` connection object is not\n  thread-safe for unsynchronized use.\n- `Storage::SCHEMA_VERSION` is `1`. It is recorded in the `schema_info` table on\n  first boot.\n- JSON is stored as text columns (`*_json`) and parsed/serialized by the\n  storage layer. `Storage.json_column(row, column, default)` centralizes the\n  parse step; `Storage.ensure_column!(db, table, column, definition)` runs the\n  incremental schema migrations.\n\nSchema is created on boot by `Storage.init_schema!`. Tables are created with\n`IF NOT EXISTS`, so restarts are safe. The `POST /v1/storage/reset` endpoint\n(and `Storage.reset!`) drops and recreates all tables for tests.\n\nTables:\n\n- `combat_sessions` — turn order, active round/turn, and per-target conditions.\n- `users` — username, password hash, role (`dm` or `player`).\n- `compendium_monsters` — stat blocks keyed by slug, including JSON tags.\n- `compendium_items` — magic items keyed by slug.\n- `campaigns` — campaign id, name, and DM username.\n- `campaign_characters` — party members belonging to a campaign.\n- `campaign_events` — session notes and open thread entries.\n- `campaign_quests` — quest headers, milestones, and completed milestones.\n- `campaign_factions` / `campaign_npcs` — factions and their NPCs.\n- `campaign_inventory` — party and per-character item quantities.\n- `campaign_crafting_projects` — downtime crafting state.\n- `campaign_sessions` / `campaign_session_attendance` — scheduled sessions and\n  attendance lists.\n- `play_campaigns`, `play_campaign_members`, `play_campaign_narrations` —\n  owned live-play campaigns, party membership, and ordered narration/action/\n  resolution events. `play_campaigns` also stores the durable `story` and\n  `dm_notes` campaign document, plus turn queue/turn-number state.\n- `play_campaign_locations` / `play_campaign_location_connections` — owned\n  location graph nodes and directed outbound travel edges per campaign.\n\n### Routing\n\nSinatra routes are grouped by domain in `app.rb`:\n\n1. Health\n2. Core dice/checks (`/v1/dice/stats`, `/v1/checks/ability`,\n   `/v1/encounters/adjusted-xp`, `/v1/initiative/order`)\n3. Characters (`/v1/characters/*`)\n4. Combat state (`/v1/combat/sessions/*`)\n5. Auth users (`/v1/auth/*`)\n6. Storage (`/v1/storage/*`)\n7. Compendium (`/v1/compendium/*`)\n8. Campaigns (`/v1/campaigns/*`) — including quests, factions/NPCs, inventory,\n   downtime crafting, and session scheduling\n9. PHB rules (`/v1/phb/*`)\n10. DM tools (`/v1/dm/*`)\n11. Campaign analytics (`/v1/campaigns/:id/analytics/*`) and audit/export\n12. Play campaigns (`/v1/play/campaigns/*`) — lobby, party membership, turn\n    queue, GM/player turn views, actions, resolutions, the campaign document,\n    and location graph\n\nEvery successful route that returns JSON calls `content_type :json` before\nproducing the body. Error halts use `json_error(status, message)`, which sets\nthe `application/json` content type and a JSON body `{\"error\":\"...\"}`. The\n`/v1/dice/stats` route is the only validation halt that omits the explicit\ncontent type, preserving the original behavior.\n\n### Helper modules\n\nSinatra helper modules are included in `app.rb`:\n\n- `GameLogic` — pure functions (ability modifier, proficiency, initiative order,\n  encounter XP/difficulty). These methods have no side effects and can be unit\n  tested in isolation.\n- `Validation` — input guards that may `halt` with a 400 response. They depend on\n  the request context through the `json_error` helper.\n- `Auth` — bearer-token extraction and role enforcement; password hashing via\n  `OpenSSL::KDF.pbkdf2_hmac`. Uses `json_error` for 401/403 halts.\n\nApp-specific helpers live in the anonymous `helpers` block in `app.rb`:\n\n- `parse_json_body` — read and parse JSON, halt 400 on parse errors.\n- `find_combat_session!` — load a combat session or halt 404.\n- `combat_session_response(session, extra = {})` — format a session for the\n  public API; optional extra keys can be merged (e.g. `conditions`).\n- `json_error` — uniform JSON halt helper.\n- `require_campaign_exists!(campaign_id)` — validate the id and halt 404 unless\n  the campaign exists.\n- `load_play_campaign!(campaign_id)` — load a play campaign or halt 404. ORDER BY rowid',\n        [campaign_id]\n      ).map do |row|\n        {\n          campaign_id: row['campaign_id'],\n          id: row['id'],\n          title: row['title'],\n          status: row['status'],\n          milestones: json_column(row, 'milestones_json'),\n          completed_milestones: json_column(row, 'completed_milestones_json')\n        }\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.campaign_quests_count(campaign_id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_quests WHERE campaign_id = ?', [campaign_id]) }\n  end\n\n  # --- Campaign inventory ---\n\n  def self.add_inventory_item(campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.transaction do\n        existing = db.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, owner]\n        )\n        if existing\n          new_quantity = existing['quantity'] + quantity\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, owner]\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity]\n          )\n        end\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.assign_equipment(campaign_id, character_id, item_slug, quantity)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.transaction do\n        party_row = db.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n        )\n        return false unless party_row && party_row['quantity'] >= quantity\n\n        new_party_quantity = party_row['quantity'] - quantity\n        if new_party_quantity.positive?\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_party_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'DELETE FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, 'party']\n          )\n        end\n\n        existing_char = db.get_first_row(\n          'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n          [campaign_id, item_slug, character_id]\n        )\n        if existing_char\n          new_char_quantity = existing_char['quantity'] + quantity\n          db.execute(\n            'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [new_char_quantity, campaign_id, item_slug, character_id]\n          )\n        else\n          db.execute(\n            'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n            [campaign_id, item_slug, character_id, quantity]\n          )\n        end\n      end\n      true\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.inventory_summary(campaign_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      party_items = db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND owner = ? AND quantity > 0',\n        [campaign_id, 'party']\n      )\n      assigned_items = db.get_first_value(\n        'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND owner != ? AND quantity > 0',\n        [campaign_id, 'party']\n      )\n      healing_potions = db.get_first_row(\n        'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n        [campaign_id, 'healing-potion', 'party']\n      )\n      healing_potions_available = healing_potions ? healing_potions['quantity'] : 0\n\n      {\n        party_items: party_items,\n        assigned_items: assigned_items,\n        healing_potions_available: healing_potions_available\n      }\n    end\n  end\n\n  # --- Campaign sessions ---\n\n  def self.campaign_session_exists?(campaign_id, id)\n    with_db { |db| db.get_first_value('SELECT 1 FROM campaign_sessions WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?', [campaign_id, id]) }\n  end\n\n  def self.load_project(campaign_id, id)\n    row = with_db { |db| db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM campaign_crafting_projects WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?', [campaign_id, id]) }\n    return nil unless row\n\n    {\n      campaign_id: row['campaign_id'],\n      id: row['id'],\n      character_id: row['character_id'],\n      item_slug: row['item_slug'],\n      days_required: row['days_required'],\n      days_completed: row['days_completed'],\n      status: row['status'],\n      cost_gp: row['cost_gp']\n    }\n  end\n\n  def self.create_project(campaign_id, id, character_id, item_slug, days_required, cost_gp)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO campaign_crafting_projects (campaign_id, id, character_id, item_slug, days_required, days_completed, status, cost_gp) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [campaign_id, id, character_id, item_slug, days_required, 0, 'active', cost_gp]\n      )\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.advance_project(campaign_id, id, days)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.transaction do\n        row = db.get_first_row('SELECT * FROM campaign_crafting_projects WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?', [campaign_id, id])\n        return nil unless row\n\n        new_completed = [row['days_completed'] + days, row['days_required']].min\n        status = new_completed >= row['days_required'] ? 'complete' : 'active'\n\n        db.execute(\n          'UPDATE campaign_crafting_projects SET days_completed = ?, status = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND id = ?',\n          [new_completed, status, campaign_id, id]\n        )\n\n        if status == 'complete'\n          existing = db.get_first_row(\n            'SELECT quantity FROM campaign_inventory WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n            [campaign_id, row['item_slug'], 'party']\n          )\n          if existing\n            db.execute(\n              'UPDATE campaign_inventory SET quantity = ? WHERE campaign_id = ? AND item_slug = ? AND owner = ?',\n              [existing['quantity'] + 1, campaign_id, row['item_slug'], 'party']\n            )\n          else\n            db.execute(\n              'INSERT INTO campaign_inventory (campaign_id, item_slug, owner, quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)',\n              [campaign_id, row['item_slug'], 'party', 1]\n            )\n          end\n        end\n\n        { id: row['id'], days_completed: new_completed, status: status }\n      end\n    end\n  end\n\n  # Sequence numbers are per-campaign and monotonically\n  # increasing so the log order matches insertion order.\n  def self.insert_narration(campaign_id, kind, actor, type, text)\n    with_db do |db|\n      sequence = (db.get_first_value('SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence), 0) FROM play_campaign_narrations WHERE campaign_id = ?', [campaign_id]) || 0).to_i + 1\n      db.execute(\n        'INSERT INTO play_campaign_narrations (campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, type, text) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)',\n        [campaign_id, sequence, kind, actor, type, text]\n      )\n      sequence\n    end\n  end\n\n  def self.create_narration(campaign_id, actor, text)\n    insert_narration(campaign_id, 'narration', actor, nil, text)\n  end\n\n  def self.create_action(campaign_id, actor, type, text)\n    insert_narration(campaign_id, 'action', actor, type, text)\n  end\n\n  def self.create_resolution(campaign_id, actor, text)\n    insert_narration(campaign_id, 'resolution', actor, nil, text)\n  end\n\n  def self.play_campaign_narrations(campaign_id)\n    with_db do |db|\n      db.execute(\n        'SELECT sequence, kind, actor, type, text FROM play_campaign_narrations WHERE campaign_id = ?
